description: Read one pricing function your workspace can use: its name, description, status, tags, cost per unit, cost multiplier, and input and output schemas. Its owner also sees whether a credential is saved for it. Another workspace's function is readable only once Last Price staff approve its marketplace listing; until then it answers Function not found, as pricing does. Needs a Last Price credential with function read scope.

function_id.description: The pricing function UUID: id on a list_functions result.
